description: This file declares the ApplicationManagementServer class, which implements the IApplicationManagementServer interface for IPC-based application management in the Rialto server. It includes methods for initialization, event sending, starting, stopping, and handling client disconnections, and manages internal IPC server components.

classes.name: ApplicationManagementServer
classes.description: Implements the IApplicationManagementServer interface, managing IPC server lifecycle, client connections, and event notifications within the Rialto server.

methods.name: ApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server with factory objects and session manager.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC server with a socket.

methods.name: sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a session state change event to clients.

methods.name: onClientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a client disconnects.
